crossRefs.note: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in…
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages.
